Position Description The Call Center Operator will serve as the first point of contact for support, providing frontline assistance and customer service via phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems. Follow established call handling scripts, knowledge base articles, and SOPs to provide information support. Communicate clearly and professionally with end users throughout the support lifecycle, providing timely status updates and follow-up on open or escalated tickets as needed. Participate in team huddles, training sessions, and knowledge sharing activities to stay current on supported systems, updated procedures, and emerging issues. Adhere to all applicable federal regulations, agency security policies, and call center operational procedures during every end user interaction. Maintain a high level of professionalism, patience, and empathy when assisting end users, including those with varying levels of technical proficiency. Meet or exceed individual performance targets including call handling metrics, ticket quality scores, customer satisfaction ratings, and schedule adherence. Required Education and Experience: High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. 1+ years of experience in a call center, help desk, customer service, or technical support role preferred Required Skills And Competencies Strong communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and professionally to end users with varying levels of technical knowledge. Demonstrated customer service skills with a patient, empathetic, and solution-oriented approach to handling end user support interactions. Ability to accurately document support interactions, issues, and resolutions in an ITSM ticketing system in a clear, concise, and timely manner. Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow established call handling procedures, knowledge base articles, and SOPs consistently and accurately. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, including active call handling, ticket documentation, and queue monitoring, in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams. Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, taking direction from supervisors and contributing to a positive and collaborative team environment. Strong time management and schedule adherence skills, with the ability to maintain consistent performance across all assigned shifts. Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance as required.
